summary: evals/backbone.py gains traced_nora_task(spec) for S2 ("which tool, with what arguments, in what order") -- no new grader needed, the SDK's own ToolCalled/ToolSelectionAccuracyEvaluator/ToolParameterAccuracyEvaluator/TrajectoryEvaluator already read the Session this adds.
details: traced_nora_task wraps nora_task(spec) with eval_task(TracedHandler()), which adds a trajectory key onto nora_task's existing output/environment_state dict without disturbing it -- S2 and S7 (AbsenceGrader) can grade the same driven case.

Corrected a wrong claim found while building this: _prefill_capture()'s docstring (S4) said it could not coexist with TracedHandler in the same process. Verified empirically, both construction orders, that it was wrong -- add_span_processor is additive and StrandsEvalsTelemetry falls back to the already-registered provider when its own set_tracer_provider is refused, so both exporters end up on one shared provider and both receive every span. Fixed in the code comment directly.

Verified mechanically (a deliberately unreachable database exercises the full before/after wrap without needing live infra) and pinned in tests/unit/test_eval_backbone.py, falsified by reverting. NOT yet verified against a real live participation case with ToolCalled actually scoring a real tool call -- 09-the-backbone-measured.md §1 measured the underlying spans exist once, live, before this session; that specific combination (traced_nora_task + a real SDK evaluator) has not itself been re-run.
